info.title: Lupira Cal API
info.description: Calendar backend for Lupira (contacts live in LupiraContactApi). Authenticate with a Bearer token issued by the OIDC provider (Authentik).

get.summary: Authenticated claims echo for dependency probes; resolves nothing, writes nothing.
The caller's resolved local identity (JIT-provisioned on first login).

post.summary: Idempotently ensure the caller has the standard calendar set; returns it. Calendars it creates get the optional body's DefaultTimezone (IANA id), else the server default; existing calendars are unchanged.

get.summary: Per-contact participation across your readable calendars (contactId, item count, most recent occurrence start, recency-weighted score), ordered by score: each past occurrence weighs 0.5^(age / 90 days), the next planned one 1. Optional from/to restricts the window. A ranking signal for contact pickers/resolvers.
List the calendars the caller can access.

post.summary: Create a calendar. DefaultTimezone (IANA id) defaults to the server default. (Address books are managed by LupiraContactApi.)

put.summary: Change a calendar's DefaultTimezone (IANA id); owner-only. Applies to items written later without a zone; existing items keep theirs.

post.summary: Grant a member access to a calendar (access = owner|read-write|read; default owner).

delete.summary: Revoke a member's access to a calendar (by email). 409 if it would remove the last owner.

get.summary: Search calendar items (text + tag + parent + attendee contact + category/status filter; recurrence expanded in-window; from/to match occurrences overlapping the window). Text queries and parent/contact filters with no from/to match all-time; otherwise the window defaults to ±1 year. skip/take page over occurrences sorted by start (desc=true for newest first). Only items accepted into a calendar you can read.

post.summary: Create a calendar item (filed into CalendarId if given, else unfiled for later curation). A location must be a resolved PlaceId.
Create many items in one call (idempotent per item on SourceKey; children reference parents by ParentSourceKey in any order). Returns a per-item result (created|existed|invalid) in input order.

put.summary: Update a calendar item. Plain fields: omitted = kept; fields paired with a *Provided sentinel are written verbatim when it is true (enables clearing recurrence, switching all-day, editing timezones, clearing the parent with ParentItemIdProvided=true and a null ParentItemId). Offline clients send Idempotency-Key (their command id) + body OccurredAt for replay-safe, last-writer-wins updates.

delete.summary: Delete a calendar item (soft delete + tombstone). A replay bearing the same Idempotency-Key succeeds instead of 404ing.

get.summary: Check-in worklist: items ranked thinnest-first by completeness score (< maxScore, default 1 = any item with gaps). Item-granular (no recurrence expansion); exempt items (system/Birthdays/Availability calendars, cancelled) are excluded. Acknowledge an inapplicable gap field by merging metadata {"completeness":{"na":["booking"]}} so it stops counting.
Calendar items anchored to a LupiraGeoApi place (its location, or a travel endpoint). Only items in a calendar you can read.

put.summary: Change one occurrence of a recurring item, addressed by its unmodified start (UTC, e.g. 2026-05-31T16:00:00Z). Excluded=true removes it from the series; otherwise StartsAt/EndsAt/Title/Description/Status override the series for that occurrence (omitted = inherit). Replaces the occurrence's previous change.

delete.summary: Revert one occurrence of a recurring item to the series (drops its exclusion or override).

post.summary: Merge arbitrary JSON metadata into a calendar item. Offline clients pass ?occurredAt= + Idempotency-Key for replay-safe, last-writer-wins merges.

put.summary: Set the LLM-interpreted payload on an item (server-side only; never in the export). 409 if the item carries an action.
Set the deterministic payload on an item (server-side only; never in the export). 409 if the item carries a prompt.

post.summary: Link a calendar item to an external reference (e.g. a LupiraTasks item, or an Activity-API engagement/project).
Link many references of one kind to an item at once (idempotent per reference) — e.g. an album's photos to its event.

delete.summary: Remove one relation from a calendar item.

post.summary: Unlink many references of one kind from an item at once (idempotent: references with no matching edge are ignored).

get.summary: Every edge of one kind the caller can see, with its item and reference — e.g. all photo links.
Reverse lookup: calendar items linked to a given external reference.

Places where your events and photos concentrate, derived at read time and ranked by active days (distinct UTC days with an event occurrence or a photo). Events come from calendars you can read (or calendarId), photos are your own. Defaults: all-time up to now, minDays 3, limit 100. A hotspot carries the LupiraGeoApi PlaceId it anchors to, else a reverse-geocoded label.
List items proposed into a calendar (awaiting accept/reject).

post.summary: Accept a proposed item into a calendar. Offline clients pass ?occurredAt= + Idempotency-Key for replay-safe, last-writer-wins filing.
File an existing item into a calendar (status=proposed|accepted, default proposed). Offline clients pass ?occurredAt= + Idempotency-Key.

delete.summary: Remove an item from a calendar (reject / unfile). Offline clients pass ?occurredAt= + Idempotency-Key.

post.summary: Invite a contact (must be a Contact id). role = chair|req-participant|opt-participant|non-participant (or the enum name); default req-participant, anything else 400s. A contact already invited is a no-op. Offline clients pass ?occurredAt= + Idempotency-Key for replay-safe delivery.

put.summary: Add a set of contacts as attendees in one call (add-only). Attended=true also marks them attended (historical backfill). Slim result (additions + already-present count), not the full item.

delete.summary: Remove a contact from the item — every participation it holds; a contact holding none is a no-op. For clients that never learned the participation id.

post.summary: Record an RSVP. status = needs-action|accepted|declined|tentative|delegated (or the enum name); required, anything else 400s. The current RSVP again is a no-op. Offline clients pass ?occurredAt= + Idempotency-Key for replay-safe delivery.
Confirm attendance; already confirmed is a no-op. Offline clients pass ?occurredAt= + Idempotency-Key for replay-safe delivery.
Record that the participant left; already left is a no-op. Offline clients pass ?occurredAt= + Idempotency-Key for replay-safe delivery.

delete.summary: Remove an attendee. Pass Idempotency-Key so a redelivered removal succeeds rather than 404s.

get.summary: Delta feed for offline mirrors: everything the caller can read that changed past the cursor, plus tombstone ids for items deleted or no longer visible. Omit since for a full sync (tombstones suppressed — replace the mirror wholesale); loop while hasMore, persisting cursor between calls.
Snapshot of the caller's calendars for mirror reconciliation. Containers are plain documents with no event history (no cursor) — fetch once per sync cycle and diff locally.

Access.description: A principal's permission on a collection. `Owner` adds member-management + delete rights over `ReadWrite`.

ActionKind.description: A deterministic, no-LLM action executed directly at fire time.

AvailabilityStatus.description: A presence/availability segment's status. A day may hold several segments (whole-day or timed).

BookingDetail.description:
A reservation/confirmation attached to any category (a booked meal, a ticketed outing, a hotel, a flight).
            `ProviderContactId` reuses a `Contact` (airline, hotel, restaurant, venue); `PartySize` covers a
            table/seat reservation; `Amount`/`Currency` the paid cost.

BootstrapRequest.description:
`DefaultTimezone` (an IANA zone id) is given to the calendars bootstrap creates; omitted = the server
        default. Calendars that already exist keep their zone.

CalendarEntryStatus.description: Curation state of a CalendarItem within a calendar. `Removed` is retained as a sync tombstone.

excludedOccurrences.description: Recurring items: unmodified starts removed from the series.

extraOccurrences.description: Recurring items: one-off starts added to the series.

occurrenceOverrides.description: Recurring items: occurrences that deviate from the series (null members inherit).

oneOf.description: Event-bound payload (server-side only). At most one of ItemPrompt? CalendarItemDto.Prompt/ItemAction? CalendarItemDto.Action is set.
How well-documented this item is (null = not applicable, e.g. exempt kinds/calendars). Drives Elicit ranking.

createdAt.description:
Server-side timestamps (from the event timeline) + stream version — the ordering/versioning
            surface offline clients key on. `Etag` stays content-derived and is orthogonal.

calendarIds.description: Accepted calendar memberships, limited to calendars the caller can read.

parentItemId.description: Hierarchy link (e.g. the trip a leg belongs to). Title only when the caller can read the parent.

childCount.description: Direct children visible to the caller, independent of the current filters.

oneOf.description: The item's own completeness (same across its occurrences; null = not applicable), so search results rank directly.
Provenance of a read-time-projected occurrence (e.g. Birthdays → a contact). Null for stored items.

CalendarItemOccurrenceDto.description: A single concrete occurrence of an item within a search window (recurrences expanded).

status.description: Tentative|Confirmed|Cancelled. Cancelled drops the occurrence while keeping it on record as cancelled.

occurredAt.description: Client wall-clock of the edit (last-writer-wins with other schedule edits). Omitted ⇒ server receive time.

ChangeOccurrenceRequest.description:
Change one occurrence of a recurring item, identified by its unmodified start. bool ChangeOccurrenceRequest.Excluded removes it
            from the series; otherwise the given members override the series for that occurrence (omitted = inherit). Each change
            replaces the occurrence's previous one.

CompletenessGap.description: A field the record is missing or thin on, with its rubric weight (heavier = ask first).

CompletenessScore.description:
How well-documented a record is: `Score` 0..1 (Σ weight·presence / Σ weight), the unmet
            fields ranked by missing mass (weight·absence, largest first), and the rubric version that produced it.
            `null` (not this type) means "not applicable".

ContainerDto.description:
A calendar the caller can access; `access` is the caller's own grant level.
            `Class`/`Kind` classify the calendar. (Address books live in LupiraContactApi.)

sourceKey.description:
Client-supplied provenance/idempotency key (e.g. an import `sourceKey`). When set, the item's stream id
            is derived from it (DeterministicGuid), so re-creating with the same key is a no-op
            that returns the existing item — safe batch/import replay. Also becomes the item's external UID. Omit for a random uid.

parentItemId.description: Nest this item under a parent (e.g. a trip's leg/sub-event). The parent must exist and be accessible to the caller.

parentSourceKey.description:
Alternative to Guid? CreateCalendarItemRequest.ParentItemId for batch imports: reference the parent by its string? CreateCalendarItemRequest.SourceKey;
            the server resolves it to the parent's deterministic id. Used when parent + children are created in one batch. Ignored if Guid? CreateCalendarItemRequest.ParentItemId is set.

location.description:
Free-text location resolved server-side to a LupiraGeoApi place (fail-closed if geo is up but can't resolve).
            Prefer Guid? CreateCalendarItemRequest.PlaceId when you have already resolved/vetted the place (places-first imports) — then string? CreateCalendarItemRequest.Location
            is used only as the display label.

placeId.description:
A pre-resolved LupiraGeoApi place id, kept with string? CreateCalendarItemRequest.Location as its label. Checked against geo: an
            unknown id is rejected, a merged-away id is stored as its survivor.

startTimezone.description: IANA zone of a timed item. Omitted ⇒ the calendar's zone, else the server default; the end zone follows it.

oneOf.description:
Confidence of the start/end date for a historical or backfilled item — the date is still a concrete day;
            this records that it is only known to the month/year/roughly. Omit for exact dates.

Optional server-side annotations (e.g. import provenance) merged onto the item at creation — same store
            as `POST /items/{id}/metadata`, saving a second call.
Sets the item's presence segment status (whole-day or timed via Starts/Ends) — availability lives on the availability calendar.
Composable detail: a `Booking` (any category) and/or a `Travel` leg (a `Trip`); Travel place refs are free-text labels.

CreateCalendarItemsBatchRequest.description:
Create many items in one call. Items may reference their parent by `ParentSourceKey` (the parent's
            `SourceKey`) in any order — the server orders parents before children. Idempotent per item on `SourceKey`.

defaultTimezone.description: IANA zone id for items written without one; omitted = the server default.

oneOf.description: Calendars only; defaults to Agenda/Generic. Ignored for address books.

CreateRelationsBatchRequest.description: Many references of one kind linked to one item in a single call (e.g. an album's photos to its event).

DeleteRelationsBatchRequest.description: Many references of one kind unlinked from one item in a single call (e.g. photos removed from an event's album).

FallbackMode.description: On a missed contract: retry once then ask (Retry), ask immediately (Ask), or drop (Drop).

GapSeverity.description: A field is fully present, weak/partial (0.5), or absent.

GrantOwnerRequest.description:
Grant a member access to a container, identified by their login `Email` (provisioned if they have
            not logged in yet). `Access` is `owner` (default), `read-write`, or `read` — case-insensitive.

id.description: `place:{placeId}` when anchored, else `cell:{lat},{lon}` of its densest ~100 m cell.

radiusM.description: Distance from the centre to the farthest contributing point.

placeId.description: The LupiraGeoApi place the hotspot anchors to.

label.description: The anchor place's name, else a reverse-geocoded label.

activeDays.description: Distinct UTC days with an event or a photo here.

HotspotDto.description: A place where the caller's events and photos concentrate, derived at read time and ranked by active days.

ItemAction.description: A deterministic payload executed directly (no LLM). `ParamsJson` carries the frozen params (e.g. a SendCheckIn message).

ItemAttendeeDto.description: One attendee's participation, composed from the participation events.

ItemBatchResult.description:
Per-item outcome of a batch create, aligned index-for-index with the request. `Status` is
            `created` | `existed` (idempotent hit on SourceKey) | `invalid` (see `Error`).

ItemDetails.description:
Composable, category-independent detail for a CalendarItem: any of a reservation (BookingDetail? ItemDetails.Booking),
a movement leg (TravelLeg? ItemDetails.Travel, a `Trip` only), or an availability segment (PresenceDetail? ItemDetails.Presence). Each is
an optional value object rather than a per-kind member, so one event can carry several at once (a booked flight sets both
BookingDetail? ItemDetails.Booking and TravelLeg? ItemDetails.Travel). Location (venue, hotel, clinic) uses the item's `PlaceId`
(a LupiraGeoApi place id) + `LocationLabel`; provider/driver references reuse a `Contact` id.

ItemDetailsRequest.description:
Composable detail input for create/update. BookingDetail? ItemDetailsRequest.Booking (reservation/confirmation) attaches to any category;
TravelLegRequest? ItemDetailsRequest.Travel applies to a `Trip` (its `ToPlace`/`FromPlace` are free-text labels resolved to a
a LupiraGeoApi place, like `Location`). A presence/availability segment is authored via the request's top-level
`Availability` field, not here. On update, a supplied member replaces that member wholesale; omitted members are kept.

ItemPrompt.description: An LLM-interpreted, contracted payload → an agent run. Declared at authoring time; enforced by assistant-api at fire time.

MeDto.description:
The resolved local identity of the caller: the stable Guid MeDto.PrincipalId plus
            current email/display name. Same identity shape (`principalId`/`email`/`displayName`)
            the platform uses everywhere it returns a person.

OccurrenceOrigin.description:
Ties a projected occurrence back to the entity it was derived from — the birthday occurrence's
            Guid OccurrenceOrigin.SourceId is the contact whose birthday it is.

OriginKind.description: What a read-time-projected occurrence was synthesized from.

OutputKind.description: The ProposedAction kind a run is contracted to yield (assistant-api validates against it; cal-api only stores it).

OwnerGrantDto.description: The result of granting a member access to a container: who now has what access on which container.

ParticipationRef.description: A newly added attendee: the contact and its assigned participation id.

ParticipationRole.description: An attendee's role in an item.

ParticipationSummaryEntry.description:
One contact's participation across the caller's readable calendars: how many items they attend(ed), the most
            recent occurrence start (past or planned), and a score — interaction weighted by recency (each past
            occurrence 0.5^(age / 90 days), the next planned one 1). A ranking signal for pickers/resolvers, not an ACL surface.

PingDto.description:
The claims a caller's token resolved to, echoed for cross-service auth-seam probes.
            Returning the audiences (not a bare 200) lets a failing consumer see which half of the seam
            is misconfigured.

PresenceDetail.description:
A presence/availability segment's status; the span is the item itself (whole-day or timed). Replaces the old
            Availability item kind — presence items live on the availability calendar and are exempt from completeness scoring.

PromptFire.description:
Fire timing (flattened union): OnStart/OnEnd carry nothing; Offset uses `OffsetMinutes` (negative = lead time);
            AllDayAt uses `AllDayAt` (local wall-clock time on the occurrence date).

PromptFireKind.description: When a payload fires relative to its item's occurrence.

PromptIntent.description: What an LLM-interpreted run should accomplish.

Ref.description: A reference the fired payload acts on. `Id` for Event/Contact/Task/Place; `Url` for External.

SectionGuardDto.description:
One section's last-writer guard: the (occurredAt, commandId) of the write that owns its current
            value. Offline clients seed their local guards from these so a pending edit on one section never blocks —
            and is never clobbered by — fresher server state on another.

SectionGuardsDto.description: Per-section guards for an item: core fields, metadata, the XOR payload, and per-calendar filing.

occurredAt.description: Client wall-clock of the edit (LWW for the payload section). Omitted ⇒ server receive time.

SetItemActionRequest.description: Set the deterministic payload on an item. Replaces any existing action; rejected (409) if the item carries a prompt.

occurredAt.description: Client wall-clock of the edit (LWW for the payload section). Omitted ⇒ server receive time.

SetItemPromptRequest.description: Set the LLM-interpreted payload on an item. Replaces any existing prompt; rejected (409) if the item carries an action.

SetParticipantsRequest.description:
Add a set of contacts as attendees of an item in one call (add-only — does not remove existing attendees).
            `Attended` also marks them attended (for historical/backfilled events); pass false for a live invite flow.

SetParticipantsResult.description:
Slim result of `set_participants` — the additions and how many were already present. Deliberately not the
            full item DTO (which would echo the whole, growing attendee list on every call).

SyncChangeDto.description: A changed item: the full DTO plus its section guards.

reset.description: Stream restarted from zero (no `since`, or readable calendars changed): a full sync from here.

deleted.description:
Ids filed to a readable calendar but no longer visible (deleted, or no accepted membership). Unknown
            ids are safe to ignore.

SyncChangesResponse.description:
One page of the changes feed. `Cursor` is opaque — hand it back as `?since=`; loop while
            `HasMore`. A full sync (no `since`, or a `Reset`) streams every live visible item and suppresses
            tombstones — the client replaces its mirror wholesale and rebases pending work.

TransportMode.description:
Mode of a TravelLeg. Rail split: `Train` = mainline/commuter, `Metro` = rapid transit,
            `Tram` = light/narrow-gauge rail; `Coach` = long-distance bus vs local `Bus`.

TravelLeg.description:
One leg of a `Trip`. Mode-agnostic: `DeparturePoint`/`ArrivalPoint` generalize gate/platform/stop,
            `Carrier` the airline/operator, `ServiceNumber` the flight/train/service number. `ToPlaceId`/`FromPlaceId`
            are LupiraGeoApi place ids with denormalized `ToLabel`/`FromLabel`; `DriverContactId` names the driver
            for a TransportMode.Car leg.

toPlaceId.description:
Pre-resolved place ids (places-first imports), checked against geo like the item's PlaceId. When set, used
            instead of resolving string? TravelLegRequest.ToPlace/string? TravelLegRequest.FromPlace text; the text, if any, is kept as the label.

TravelLegRequest.description: `ToPlace`/`FromPlace` are free-text labels resolved to a LupiraGeoApi place id + label; `DriverContactId` is a <see cref="!:Contact" /> id.

placeId.description:
Re-anchor the location to a resolved LupiraGeoApi place; string? UpdateCalendarItemRequest.Location then carries the display
            label. Set bool UpdateCalendarItemRequest.PlaceIdProvided with a null value to clear. Free-text-only location changes are rejected
            (resolve via geo first); an id geo doesn't know is rejected, a merged-away id is stored as its survivor.

isAllDay.description: Switch between timed and all-day (null ⇒ kept). All-day items carry their span in StartDate/EndDate.

startTimezone.description:
IANA timezone names annotating the timed start/end. An update that makes the item timed or sets a recurrence
            rule without a zone gets the calendar's zone, else the server default; the end zone follows the start.

recurrenceRule.description:
RFC 5545 recurrence rule. Non-null sets it; to CLEAR recurrence send null with
            bool UpdateCalendarItemRequest.RecurrenceRuleProvided = true (a bare null keeps the existing rule).

oneOf.description: Revise the start/end date confidence (see DatePrecision? CreateCalendarItemRequest.StartPrecision). Omitted ⇒ kept.

parentItemId.description:
Re-nest under a parent item (or set for the first time). Must exist, be accessible and not be the item
            itself; omitted ⇒ kept. Set bool UpdateCalendarItemRequest.ParentItemIdProvided with a null value to clear.

category.description: Reclassify the item (enum name). Changing the category drops the previous details.

oneOf.description: Change the item's presence segment status.
Composable detail to set/merge: a `Booking` and/or a `Travel` leg; a supplied member replaces that member wholesale.

occurredAt.description:
Client wall-clock of the edit, for last-writer-wins conflict resolution of the core section.
            Omitted ⇒ server receive time (online callers never need it).

UpdateCalendarItemRequest.description:
Core-field update. Two merge conventions coexist: a plain nullable field means "omitted ⇒ kept" (the original
contract, unchanged for existing callers); fields that must also be *clearable* to null carry a paired
`*Provided` sentinel — when the sentinel is true the field's value (including null) is written verbatim.
Offline clients replay whole-section writes, so they set every sentinel and send the full core section.

UpdateCalendarRequest.description:
Changes a calendar's settings. `DefaultTimezone` is an IANA zone id; it applies to items written later
            without a zone of their own, never to existing items.

Bearer.description: OIDC bearer token. Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
